title: CB4-F: seal h7_cb4_era and h7_cb4_series (listing hashes; D_split4 time-ordered split with 3-day embargo; trial lines; access logs)
expected_value: fixes both h7 datasets before any CB4 result exists
outputs: docs/research_lab/seals/h7_cb4_{era,series}_SEAL.json (byte copies, series includes D_split4) or h7_cb4_<run>_NOT_RUN.json
next_action: Claude session: commit docs/research_lab/seals/h7_cb4_era_SEAL.json and h7_cb4_series_SEAL.json (or the NOT_RUN records)
notes: Era is sealed first (its sample ids are the overlap exclusion for the series). The split uses t0 dates and market ids only; no price, trade or outcome file is opened. Drops series units with an h7_cb4_era member by id (counted in SEAL.json split). Refuses to seal an unfinished run that T_seal has not cut; a not_run_deadline run is recorded (NOT_RUN record, never sealed) and the other run is still sealed (exit 0). Idempotent: an existing seal is verified and reported, never rewritten. Verify later with scripts/run_cb4.py verify-seal. | Freeze-check fix 11: depends on the deadline recorder (q0083b) instead of q0081/q0082, so a failed or never-started fetch cannot block the seal of the other run; it therefore runs at or after T_seal (the fetches are terminal by then, or recorded not run).
